FULLMOONKNIGHT-KNIGHT.title: The Knight
FULLMOONKNIGHT-KNIGHT.description:
Raised by her grandmother, Little Red grew up on wits and fists.
Now a patrol knight, she sets out on the night of the full moon.
FULLMOONKNIGHT-KNIGHT.aromaPrinciple: [sine][blue]Settle every trouble before the moon rises.[/blue][/sine]
FULLMOONKNIGHT-KNIGHT.eventDeathPreventi: Grandma is still waiting for me.
FULLMOONKNIGHT-KNIGHT.goldMonologue: [sine]Enough to buy Grandma a big house...[/sine]
FULLMOONKNIGHT-KNIGHT.cardsModifierDescr: Knight cards will now appear in rewards and shops.
